# Every string a capture can hold, by JSON path, and what Redact does to it
# (#149). TestRedactionClassifiesEveryString fails for a path missing here,
# so a new field is classified before it ships:
#   kept      shared as is: models, versions, sizes, device facts
#   redacted  emptied: identifies this machine or its owner (serials, UUIDs,
#             MAC and Bluetooth addresses, hostname, personal paths, labels)
#   month     a manufacture date, kept to its month
# Redacted paths must be cleared in Redact (internal/report/redact.go);
# every Identity block's serial and date are handled there generically.
# x[] is a list element, x{key} a map key, x{} a map value.
